title: 대한민국과 아메리카합중국 간의 상호방위조약 제4조에 의한 시설과 구역 및 대한민국에서의 합중국 군대의 지위에 관한 협정의 시행에 관한 민사특별법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
title_original: 대한민국과 아메리카합중국 간의 상호방위조약 제4조에 의한 시설과 구역 및 대한민국에서의 합중국 군대의 지위에 관한 협정의 시행에 관한 민사특별법 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 2 (Application for Referral, etc. Regarding Claims)
(1) Applications for referral or other necessary actions pursuant to Article 8(1) of the "Enforcement Decree of the Special Civil Act Regarding the Implementation of the Agreement between the Republic of Korea and the United States of America on Facilities, Areas, and the Status of the U.S. Military in Korea (Article 4 of the Mutual Defense Treaty)" (hereinafter referred to as "the Decree") shall be made using Form No. 1 as specified. In this case, when an attorney makes the application, they must attach a power of attorney and copies of the identification documents of the applicant and the attorney.
(2) The Minister of Justice, upon receiving the application as described in (1), shall investigate the submitted evidence and materials, and in order to clearly determine the purpose and reasons for the application, may ask the applicant to provide information or materials related to the factual or legal aspects.
(3) The Minister of Justice may take the following actions in accordance with Article 8(3) of the Decree:
1. Verification of facts regarding the U.S. military stationed in the Republic of Korea (hereinafter referred to as "the U.S. Military").
2. Verification of whether the U.S. Military is liable.

3. Recommendation for the amicable resolution of disputes with the Combined Chinese Army
4. Review of the validity of the reasons if the Combined Chinese Army does not admit responsibility
5. Necessary actions for the joint committee meeting as stipulated in Article 23(10) of the "Agreement on Facilities, Areas, and the Status of the Combined Chinese Army in the Republic of Korea under Article 4 of the Mutual Defense Treaty between the Republic of Korea and the United States"
